name: Counselor-in-Training (CIT), East Brunswick Day Camp
what_you_do: Help counselors run a group of Kool Kids campers who are going into grades 1 and 2. You take mini trainings. You also write and lead at least one activity for your group.
who_can_apply: East Brunswick resident teens who want to work with children and be a camp counselor. The page does not give an age range. Needs an application and an interview.
pay_detail: Not a paid position: CITs are campers learning to be counselors. 2026 registration fee was $600, with no payment plan.
duration: All 6 weeks of camp (June 29 to August 7 in 2026)
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 29 to Aug 7, 2026. 2027 application dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the CIT application on the page, then interview.
notes: The township lists separate paid seasonal jobs on its Recreation and Parks jobs page. They include Camp Daisy, Crystal Springs and parks staff. The ages for those were not read.
